title: Copilot Studio - Information regarding the end of support for selected AI models
body:
We are announcing the end of support for selected AI models on the GitHub Copilot harnesses in Copilot Studio. Beginning on each models' applicable migration date, the selected models will no longer be available in Copilot Studio, and agents will automatically migrate to a replacement model.

 

How does this affect me? 
 

Agents configured with retiring models will be automatically migrated to a supported replacement model. The planned replacement model and migration date depend on both the model and the harness used by the agent. 

 

Review your agents by harness and model to identify those using a retiring model, then work with their owners to prepare for migration. 

 

For the latest model availability, see GitHub Copilot harness model availability.

Reminder: Previously announced EU/EFTA model retirement (November 6, 2026)

 

 

As previously announced in Message Center post MC1542165, the retirement of GPT-5 Chat on the GitHub Copilot harness will begin November 30, 2026, for Microsoft Copilot Studio environments that meet both conditions below: 

- The environment is in the European Union (EU) or European Free Trade Association (EFTA), excluding the United Kingdom (U.K.). 

- The Move data across regions administrator setting is turned off. 

 

Beginning November 30, 2026, affected environments will start migrating from GPT-5 Chat to GPT-6 Luna.

 

 

FedRAMP customers are not affected by this retirement. GPT-5 Chat will continue to be available in FedRAMP environments after November 30, 2026.

What action do I need to take?
 

Before the migration date for each retiring model, we recommend admins and makers take the following actions:  

 

- Identify affected agents in the Power Platform admin center by going to Manage > Copilot Studio and reviewing agents by harness and model.  

- The model field is currently in preview. The inventory reflects published agent configurations, so unpublished model changes might not appear. See the admin agent inventory for details.  

- Notify the appropriate agent owners.  

- Test the planned replacement model, or choose another supported model that better meets quality, performance, or cost requirements.  

- Validate response accuracy, key workflows, tool and action execution, and business-critical integrations.  

- Adjust agent instructions or configuration if testing identifies behavior changes.  

- Review model availability, regional availability, and any cross-geo or external model-provider requirements.  

- If appropriate, select a supported replacement model before the automatic migration begins. No manual model change is required if you intend to use the planned replacement. 

  

 For more information, please visit:   

- Test your agent 

- Copilot Studio model lifecycle guidance 

- Copilot Studio agent inventory
